paragraphs: RetailAI is an AI-powered voice ordering platform that helps you shop faster and smarter across restaurants, groceries, pharmacies and more.
Speak naturally or type your order, choose instant or scheduled delivery, track your orders in real time, and enjoy a seamless shopping experience.

chat.text: I want to order Chicken Biryani and 2 Cold Coffees
Sure! I've added them to your cart.
